The Model

What Is Fractional Leadership?

Fractional leadership places an experienced senior executive inside a business on a part-time, embedded basis, rather than as a full-time hire. It augments core staff with the experience and wisdom of a seasoned leader, scaled to the time commitment and budget the role actually calls for. Adoption of this model continues to accelerate as companies seek senior-level leadership without the cost structure of a full-time executive.

Engagements are structured to fit how you work: scope-based monthly retainers for ongoing fractional support, hourly arrangements for defined projects, and commission or equity-based structures considered on a case-by-case basis for the right fit.
